question: Pt. Satish Vyas was conferred upon the prestigious Tansen Samman in December 2020. He was associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santoor.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satish Vyas** is a **santoor**__ player from India.

 __
 
• **C. R. Vyas**, an Indian classical vocalist, is his father.
 
• He has been a splendid musician for over **30 years.**
 
• He was conferred upon the prestigious **Tansen Samman in December 2020.**
 
• He has performed at famous locations all over the world.
 
• In 2019, he performed for the Raag-Mala Music Society of Toronto at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto, Canada.
 
• He was honoured with the **Padma Shri in 2003.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
